narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
intent: To demonstrate that net housing additions in England have consistently failed to meet the annual target over the period from 2000 to 2019.

units.meaning: Across the series, net housing additions stay below the annual target referenced in the narration; the highest annual value, 247,770 in 2018-19, is still short of that target.

basis.note: maximum annual value; if the maximum is below the target, no year reaches it. The target number itself is not in the table.

accepted_routes: No year reaches the annual target; even the best year, 2018-19, has 247,770 net additions and remains below target.
The series stays under the target throughout; its maximum is 247,770 in 2018-19.
The target is never met, with 2018-19 the closest year at 247,770.
units.visual_evidence_rule: A visible target reference and the 2018-19 maximum mark must make the maximum appear below the target.
units.temporal_anchor: the clause 'we've consistently not hit this target'
units.reviewer_question: Should target shortfall be required even though the target value is not in the table?

units.meaning: The end of the period is much higher than the start: net additions rise from 132,000 in 2000-01 to 247,770 in 2018-19, an increase of 115,770; the final value is about 1.88 times the initial value.
accepted_routes: Starts at 132,000 in 2000-01 and ends at 247,770 in 2018-19.
Rises by about 116,000 over the period.
The final value is roughly 1.88 times the initial value.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The first and last annual marks must be visible or labeled so their values can be compared.
units.temporal_anchor: the period framing (2000-2019) / opening period statement
units.reviewer_question: Should the start-to-end increase be required, or is the target shortfall alone enough?

units.meaning: There is a pronounced mid-period fall: net additions drop from 223,530 in 2007-08 to 130,610 in 2012-13, a decline of 92,920 (about 42%).
accepted_routes: After a mid-2000s high, it reaches its lowest point at 130,610.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The 2007-08 high and 2012-13 low must be visible or labeled sufficiently to see the decline.
units.temporal_anchor: the 'consistently' clause, if used for mid-period context
units.reviewer_question: Should the mid-period decline be required, or is it optional context?

units.meaning: After the 2012-13 low of 130,610, net additions recover to 247,770 by 2018-19, an increase of 117,160 (about 90%, nearly doubling).
accepted_routes: The final value is nearly double the 2012-13 low.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The 2012-13 low and 2018-19 endpoint must be visible or labeled to see the recovery.
units.temporal_anchor: the 'consistently' clause, if used for late-period recovery
units.reviewer_question: Should the post-2012 recovery be required, or optional context?

units.meaning: The final 2018-19 maximum of 247,770 exceeds the earlier 2007-08 peak of 223,530 by 24,240 (about 11%).
accepted_routes: The 2018-19 value of 247,770 is above the 2007-08 peak of 223,530.
The end-of-period maximum is about 24,000 higher than the mid-2000s high.
The new high at 2018-19 is roughly 11% above the 2007-08 level.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The 2007-08 local peak and 2018-19 maximum must be visible or labeled for comparison.
units.temporal_anchor: the 'consistently' clause, if used for final comparison
units.reviewer_question: Should the final maximum exceeding the earlier peak be required, or optional comparison?

optional_valid: The 2010-11 point is 137,390, a local low around the middle of the period.
The 2017-18 point is 228,170, just below the 2018-19 maximum.
From 2000-01 to 2007-08, net additions rise from 132,000 to 223,530.
unsupported_to_avoid: Citing the spoken annual target as if it were a table value or deriving it from table cells.
Causal claims such as the financial crisis causing the mid-period fall.
Extrapolating beyond 2018-19 or claiming future delivery.
Using relative_value as a percentage; it is a 0-1 normalization, not a share.
Comparing to other countries, tenures, or housing types not in the table.
Saying the series is monotonic or smooth; the table shows rises and falls.
notes: The table has absolute net additional dwellings, not the target; target-related units avoid citing the target number and use only the table maximum to show shortfall. Years not explicitly labeled are inferred from annual row order between 2000-01, 2010-11, and 2018-19.
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
